purpose: Inspect and resolve explicit local mounts for shared AXM capability fabrics while preserving truthful local fallbacks and performing no hidden network fetch.

properties.source_id: optional exact source id: hands-fabric, organ-fabric, organ-archive, or visual-effect-fabric
properties.overrides: optional object mapping exact source ids to explicit local paths; an explicit missing path is reported and never silently replaced by fallback

relationships: prefers caller-supplied or locally mounted shared Fabric bodies when present
reports current UC Hands capsules and organ bodies as explicit local fallbacks rather than pretending they are mirrors of the newer shared Fabrics
marks Organ Archive preservation-only and never treats archive presence as executable or canonical authority
performs no network cloning, downloading, publishing, or mutation
path availability never transfers CANON, permission, publication, or user authority
limitations: this capability resolves local source availability; it does not automatically install, update, execute, or synchronize an external Fabric
a local fallback may be a pinned donor snapshot or local body rather than the preferred shared Fabric
runtime adapters remain responsible for validating any specific Hand or Organ before invocation
persistent_state: none; source mounts and existing local bodies are observed read-only

truth.basis: Preferred mounts, fallbacks, missing explicit paths, and network behavior are reported separately instead of collapsing source availability into capability claims.

agency.basis: Explicit source overrides are authoritative and are never silently replaced when missing; no source lookup grants permission or CANON authority.

continuity.basis: Existing UC local bodies remain valid fallbacks while shared Fabrics become the preferred reusable source boundary.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The resolver adds source indirection without deleting proven local bodies or pretending unmounted repositories are available.
